summary: Context-only committee read as of 2026-09-12: the measured tape is RISK_ON (66), but the regime is unusually transitional and internally uneven. Confirmed US Q3 has only 0.307 confidence and is no longer supported by its own axes; raw signs indicate Q2 and have completed 3 of 7 confirmation sessions. Breadth is weak (33.7% above 50-day; 3 new highs versus 22 new lows), while volatility is normalizing and dealer gamma has returned long, so the evidence supports caution and selective interpretation rather than a directional escalation. The risk radar is advisory CAUTION, not an edge: its measured 21-session pullback rate is 16.0% versus a 17.8% base rate. Liquidity is expanding mechanically through a $141B TGA drawdown, with only 9% of the impulse from Fed assets; this is a transient, low-quality tailwind and RRP is exhausted. Factor intelligence is immature: only nine dates, history floor unmet, no Pair G records, no factor attention history, and the named low-beta leader has negative IC. No signal, trade, rank, sizing change, or escalation is originated by this memo.

Commodity context changed repeatedly between buy-the-dip/trend-follow and top-watch/turn-signaled, indicating unstable state labeling rather than a durable conclusion.
contradictions_review: Five contradiction edges are visible. The central macro tension is bonds/FX versus the confirmed Q3 equity regime; the label itself is also contradicted by current growth/inflation axes. The briefing records 31 ticker-level demand-versus-supply divergences, including PANW, MNST, KVUE, and TKO, but these are descriptive and not ranking inputs. One options contradiction exists for AZO based on rising put skew; by charter this can only de-escalate a long thesis. Pair G factor contradictions are absent because the panel has only nine dates and requires at least 60, so absence means unavailable coverage, not agreement. Open master-brain theses require attention: several conflict with current context or have reached their own falsifier/check dates without being scored, and the ledger contains duplicate IDs across different subjects.
